title: Quimper and its agglomeration say a cyberattack is disrupting their internal information system
date_note: The joint communiqué is dated Monday 23 November 2026 and gives no detection date; ICI and franceinfo also give no earlier day.
org: Ville de Quimper and Quimper Bretagne Occidentale
geo_basis: victim's city (the city of Quimper and its agglomeration)
summary: The city of Quimper and Quimper Bretagne Occidentale said in a joint communiqué on 23 November that a cyberattack is disrupting their internal information system, with no impact on users and public services continuing, though some requests may take longer to process. They say security measures were put in place on detection, ANSSI was notified and cybersecurity experts are working on it. ICI reports there is no information on possible data theft.
plain: The French city of Quimper and its surrounding agglomeration say a cyberattack has disrupted their internal computer systems. They say residents are not affected, though some requests may take longer.
exec: A French city and its agglomeration say a cyberattack disrupted their internal information system; they say public services continue but some requests may be slower.
